prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
ai_overview_text:
The best AI video generators for ads depend on your specific marketing needs, budget, and workflow:
Creatify AI: Best for e-commerce and performance marketing. It converts product URLs directly into conversion-focused video ads, featuring automated scripts, AI avatars, A/B testing, and performance tracking. Creatify AI +1
HeyGen: Best for multilingual localization and brand explainers. It offers hyper-realistic AI presenters, automated scripts, and voiceovers across over 175 languages. YouTube +2
Arcads: Best for User-Generated Content (UGC)-style performance ads. It specializes in realistic AI actors, customizable avatars, and high-converting ad formats. YouTube
Topview: Best for automated end-to-end production. It uses AI agents to plan video structures, study viral hooks from product links or ideas, and generate full multi-shot ads. YouTube·Ai Lockup +1
InVideo AI: Best for quick, prompt-to-social video creation. It builds complete video ads from a simple text prompt, complete with stock footage, voiceovers, and dynamic editing. invideo AI +1Zeely: Best for mobile-first small businesses and startups. It creates scroll-stopping vertical ads for TikTok, Instagram, and Facebook in minutes using AI templates and avatars. zeely.aiRunway (Gen-3 Alpha) / Higgsfield AI: Best for cinematic, high-end, and custom-styled brand commercials where fine camera control and visual aesthetics are the priority. Reddit·r/generativeAI
If you tell me what kind of product or service you are advertising and which platform you plan to run the ads on (like TikTok, Meta, or YouTube), I can recommend the exact tool and budget tier for your campaign.
